g.text: SD02 — Venue recommendation: how the agent uses tools (F03, UC03)
This "think → call tool → observe" loop is the same for every AI feature.
[until the LLM gives a final answer (max 8 steps)]
[the LLM asks to call a tool]
the tool is NOT run; the error is
sent back to the LLM to correct itself
venue must come from the tool results
Organizer picks one venue → review & apply (see SD03)
